review_notes.note: BH middle output feeds AD through its return to row 30. Positive latch outputs feed the lower DC/DJ inputs as well as the printed true-output lines. Passive resistor portions terminate their corresponding middle outputs. P2 and P0 rails, OR-feedback rails, unjoined crossings and every native diamond traced. Positive latch outputs are commoned only through their printed outside diamonds. No connector table; title 00 ◇ 01, LOG 153A and one revision retained.

FE/FL lower true-output bends are plain elbows, independently checked in native31/native33; only their D12/B10 commoning points carry diamonds.
